questions.question: Does your organization have a formal Information Security Program established?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation of cybersecurity & data protection governance controls
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": -Require justification with submission of org chart and identification of who oversees InfoSec governance and roles involved on InfoSec team. -Require timeline for implementation if vendor conveys that formalization is in process. If vendor cannot provide any of the above remediation evidence: -Escalate to TPRM Program Manager for risk acceptance, alternate controls/remediation plans or rejection directive.

questions.question: Does your organization have a published set of Information Security policies, standards and procedures?
questions.control_objective: The organization establishes, maintains and disseminates cybersecurity & data protection policies, standards and procedures.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": -Escalate to TPRM Program Manager for risk acceptance, alternate controls/remediation plans or rejection directive.

questions.question: Does your organization have a public information security policy?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request URL or copy of public policy; If answer is "No": Notate in reviewer comments in column I.

questions.question: Does your organization document role descriptions including relevant cybersecurity & data protection responsibilities?
questions.control_objective: The organization assigns a qualified individual with the mission and resources to centrally-manage, coordinate, develop, implement and maintain an enterprise-wide cybersecurity & data protection program.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Notate in reviewer comments in column I & escalate.

questions.question: Is there a procedure in place for overseeing cybersecurity and data protection controls, that includes how issues are escalated to leadership?
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to provide a cybersecurity & data protection controls oversight function that reports to the organization's executive leadership.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request description of how risks are escalated to leadership. Notate response in reviewer comments in column I & escalate.

questions.question: Will you be using any contractors or sub-contractors to complete the engagement with Client XYZ?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request list of contractors/subcontractors; Verify trickle down contractor obligations and mandated notification of changes are flagged for Legal Review on the summary tab. If answer is "No": Self attestation is sufficient.

questions.question: Do you have a third-party risk management program/policy in place?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation of third-party management controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request copy of TPRM policy if not already received (required doc for all vendors); If answer is "No": Lack of a formal TPRM program is a sign of a significant deficiency and should be escalated unless the vendor criticality is SC0 - No access at all. Escalate. Verify contractual requirement for TPRM adherence is flagged for Legal Review on the summary tab.

questions.question: Please attach your Third-Party Risk Management Policy.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request copy of TPRM policy if not already received (required doc for all vendors); If answer is "No": Escalate. Require implementation plan if missing. Verify contractual requirement for TPRM adherence is flagged for Legal Review on the summary tab.

questions.question: Does your third-party risk management program include supply chain protections?
questions.control_objective: The organization utilizes security safeguards to limit harm from potential adversaries who identify and target the organization's supply chain.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request description of supply chain security measures/controls. If answer is "No": Request justification as to why not implemented. Notate in reviewer comments in column I and escalate. Verify supply chain contractual protection verbiage is flagged for Legal Review on the summary tab.

questions.question: Do your vendor and subcontractor agreements include clauses requiring adherence to cybersecurity and data privacy standards, and do these requirements flow down to all applicable subcontractors and suppliers?
questions.control_objective: The organization ensures cybersecurity & data privacy requirements are included in contracts that flow-down to applicable sub-contractors and suppliers.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request sample agreements/screenshot of agreement terms; If answer is "No": Verify security/privacy clauses and mandated flow-down obligations are flagged for Legal Review in the summary tab.

questions.question: Do you provide security awareness training at onboarding and at least annually thereafter for all personnel including contractors?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation of security workforce development and awareness controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Ask if there are plans to implement and implementation date, notate response in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: How frequently are employees trained on policies in your organization?
questions.reviewer_playbook: Options are: We don't have a formal cadence, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Annually, Semi-Annually, Bienally, Other, N/A If vendor selects any of the following:"We don't have a formal cadence", "Other","N/A", you will see their justification for the response and not the selection itself. Notate the justification in the reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Does your organization provide role based security awareness training at least annually?
questions.control_objective: The organization provides all employees and contractors appropriate awareness education and training that is relevant for their job function.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Ask for justification and/or cadence if the cadence is not annual. Notate response in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Does your organization have privacy controls and or Data Privacy program in place?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation and operation of data privacy controls. The organization facilitates the implementation of security workforce development and awareness controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Determine from the vendor profile tab if vendor will have access to Regodit network or Regodit data. If vendor will have access to either, notate the scope of engagement in the reviewer comments and escalate.

questions.question: Will your personnel or your product require access to sensitive data (i.e PII, PI, PHI) to complete the engagement with Regodit?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request data handling procedures. Notate receipt of docs in the reviewer comments column I. Save docs under vendor profile in Navex AND SharePoint. Verify encryption, access controls, and breach notification clauses are flagged for Legal Review on the summary tab. Escalate if vendor pushes back or cannot provide. If answer is "No": Self attestation is sufficient.

questions.question: Please provide a copy of your data retention schedule and secure disposal procedures
questions.control_objective: Ensure that personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill its intended purpose and is securely disposed of when no longer needed.
questions.reviewer_playbook: Documents only required if vendor has access to Regodit data. If vendor has access but cannot or will not provide documentation, notate responses and scope of engagement in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Do you have a privacy policy in place? If so, please provide the attachment or URL.
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to disclose Personal Data (PD) to third parties only for the purposes identified in the data privacy notice and with the implicit or explicit consent of the data subject
questions.reviewer_playbook: Documents only required if vendor has access to Regodit data. If vendor has access but cannot or will not provide documentation, notate responses and scope of engagement in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Does your organization ensure privacy requirements are extended to contractors and service providers through contractual agreements, and that roles and responsibilities concerning data privacy are clearly understood and documented?
questions.control_objective: The organization includes data privacy requirements in contracts and other acquisition-related documents that establish data privacy roles and responsibilities for contractors and service providers.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request sample agreements/screenshot of agreement terms; If answer is "No": Verify security/privacy clauses and mandated flow-down obligations are flagged for Legal Review in the summary tab.

questions.question: Do you, or any third party you use to deliver services to Client XYZ, store sensitive information outside the United States? If so, where?
questions.control_objective: The organization inventories, documents, and maintains data flows for data that is resident (permanently or temporarily) within a service’s geographically distributed applications (physical and virtual), infrastructure, systems components, and/or shared with other third-parties. This includes identifying where data is stored, processed, or transmitted across borders and ensuring compliance with statutory, regulatory, and contractual obligations.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request list of data storage locations. Verify requirement to comply with Regodit data residency requirements is flagged for Legal Review. Escalate for high-risk jurisdictions. If answer is "No": Self attestation is sufficient.

questions.question: Do you require data-at-rest encryption for sensitive data?
questions.control_objective: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Determine if vendor will have access to Regodit data from the vendor profile tab. If vendor will have access, request encryption policy and evidence/screenshot of implementation. Escalate if vendor pushes back or cannot provide. If answer is "No": Notate scope of engagement in the reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Do you require data-in-transit encryption for sensitive data? If so, please describe the encryption protocols used.
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cryptographic protections controls using known public standards and trusted cryptographic technologies.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request details of encryption protocols. If vendor response is not TLS 1.2+, notate response in reviewer comments in column I and escalate. If answer is "No": Notate scope of engagement in the reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Will Regodit data be stored on site, in a data center, or by a third party?
questions.control_objective: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
questions.reviewer_playbook: Options available to vendors are: On-Site, Data Center(Controlled by you), Cloud(Controlled by you), Cloud(Controlled by a third-party), N/A, Other If vendor has no access to Regodit data, vendor response should be "N/A". For all other responses: Request storage locations, 3rd party company name if applicable, security certifications for any vendor owned data centers. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you have data retention policies and procedures for the secure disposal of information?
questions.control_objective: Organization must implement controls to protect data wherever it is stored, transmitted, and processed, in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory, and contractual compliance obligations. This includes defining retention periods for both sensitive and non-sensitive/regulated data and implementing processes to dispose of, destroy, erase, and/or anonymize data once it is no longer necessary for business purposes.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If vendor has access to Regodit data: Request retention and disposal policies. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents received from vendor. If no access to Regodit data, docs are not required.

questions.question: If providing a product or SaaS platform that will access, store, or process Client XYZ data, are you able to provide applicable data flow diagrams showing how Regodit's data will flow through the tool upon request?
questions.reviewer_playbook: Options available to vendors are: Yes, No, N/A If answer is "Yes": Request data flow diagrams. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents received from vendor. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents received from vendor. If answer is "N/A": Determine if vendor will have access to Regodit data by evaluating engagement scope and escalate as needed.

questions.question: Is there a policy in place for physical security requirements for your business?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the operation of physical and environmental protection controls
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Self attestation is sufficient if no access to Regodit locations. If vendor will need access to Regodit locations: Request physical security policy. If answer is "No": Self attestation is sufficient if no access to Regodit locations. If vendor will need access to Regodit locations: Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you require physical access to any Client XYZ locations to complete your engagement?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request physical security policy. Find out which Regodit location will be accessed and provide the relevant visitor management policy to the vendor for review and acceptance. Ask for a 1st party attestation that backgrounds checks have been performed on the personnel visiting the Regodit location. If answer is "No": Self attestation is sufficient, if no access to Regodit locations. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Are you willing to accept and acknowledge the expectations outlined in Client XYZ's Visitor Management document?
questions.control_objective: The organization maintains a current list of personnel with authorized access to organizational facilities (except for those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" and vendor needs access to Regodit locations: Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Require signed acknowledgment before engagement start. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Does your organization have procedures in place to track assets that are brought onto Client XYZ sites?
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to perform inventories of technology assets that: Accurately reflect the current systems, applications, and services in use; Identify authorized software products, including business justification details; Are at the level of granularity deemed necessary for tracking and reporting; Include organization-defined information necessary to achieve effective property accountability; Are available for review and audit by designated organizational personnel.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request asset tracking procedures. Verify clause for mandatory onsite asset reporting is flagged for legal review in the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Can you provide your organization's data protection policy, including evidence of physical safeguards for devices used onsite if requested?
questions.control_objective: Regodit must implement controls to protect data wherever it is stored, transmitted, and processed, in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory, and contractual compliance obligations. This includes defining retention periods for both sensitive and non-sensitive/regulated data and implementing processes to dispose of, destroy, erase, and/or anonymize data once it is no longer necessary for business purposes.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Will Client XYZ be using a web application provided by you?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" Security Question ID#30 : Request application details. If answer is "No" to Security Question ID#30: Security Question ID#'s 31,32,33,34,35,36 and 37 are not no longer required.

questions.question: What is the name of your web application?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" Security Question ID#30 : Request application details including name and function/purpose. If answer is "No" to Security Question ID#30: Security Question ID#'s 31,32,33,34,35,36 and 37 are not no longer required.

questions.question: What is the function/purpose of your web application?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" Security Question ID#30 : Request application details including name and function/purpose. If answer is "No" to Security Question ID#30: Security Question ID#'s 31,32,33,34,35,36 and 37 are not no longer required.

questions.question: How do you report application security vulnerabilities?
questions.control_objective: Define and manage the attack surface by identifying vulnerabilities, applying patches, and maintaining secure configurations across systems.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" Security Question ID#30 : Request vulnerability reporting process; Verify remediation expectations/SLA's; Verify disclosure obligation verbiage is flagged for Legal review on the summary tab. If answer is "No" to Security Question ID#30: Security Question ID#'s 31,32,33,34,35,36 and 37 are not no longer required.

questions.question: Does your web application have an SSL/TLS certificate?
questions.control_objective: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality of data being transmitted.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Request SSL certificate evidence. Require remediation if absent. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Does your application offer single sign-on (SSO) or are there plans to implement/offer SSO in the near future? If plans to implement in near future, include an implementation date in your justification.
questions.control_objective: The organization identifies and authenticates third-party systems and services.
questions.reviewer_playbook: Request SSO capability details; require implementation timeline; escalate if critical for engagement.

questions.question: Do you have policies, procedures or standards in place for secure development practices?
questions.control_objective: Align SDLC documentation with SCF standards and include secure coding elements.
questions.reviewer_playbook: Request secure development policies; require remediation plan if missing; mandate adherence to OWASP standards.

questions.question: Do you utilize Secure Coding Principles - (Detailed logging, encrypted credentials, etc.)?
questions.control_objective: Applications must be developed using secure coding principles to prevent vulnerabilities in web applications.
questions.reviewer_playbook: Request evidence of secure coding practices; require remediation if absent; mandate code review processes.

questions.question: Are internal vulnerability scans performed?
questions.control_objective: The organization detects vulnerabilities and configuration errors by conducting recurring vulnerability scans of systems and web applications. Remediate vulnerabilities based on risk level: High-risk: within 30 days Moderate-risk: within 90 days Low-risk: within 180 days
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: On what cadence are vulnerability scans performed?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "We don't have a formal cadence", "Other" or "N/A": Request scan frequency details, if not provided; Escalate for critical gaps. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: What are the documented remediation timelines for critical and high patches?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation and monitoring of vulnerability and patch management controls to reduce exposure to known threats.
questions.reviewer_playbook: Request patch timelines. Recommend contractual SLAs for Legal Review (critical within 30 days, high within 60 days); If timelines provided are not compliant, notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: What is the process for disaster recovery and backups?
questions.control_objective: Maintain and update BC/DR plans regularly to reflect changes in business operations, technology, and risk landscape.
questions.reviewer_playbook: DR Documentation Required; require remediation plan if missing. Verify mandated backup verbiage is flagged for Legal review in the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Please provide a copy of your BC/DR policy for review.
questions.control_objective: Define criteria to initiate BC/DR plans that support business continuity operations capable of meeting Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
questions.reviewer_playbook: Required submission of BC/DR policy; escalate if unavailable; Recommend mandatory periodic testing to be included in contract provision. If non-compliant, notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you keep a record of security events?
questions.control_objective: The organization must utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM) or similar automated tool to support the centralized collection of security-related event logs.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self attestation is sufficient. Recommend mandatory log retention in contract for Legal review. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor. Recommend mandatory log retention in contract for Legal review.

questions.question: Do you monitor the security of your wireless networks?
questions.control_objective: Develop, govern, and update procedures to implement network security controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No" and Vendor will have access to our network: Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you have an incident response plan in place? If yes, describe briefly.
questions.control_objective: The organization maintains and makes available a current and viable Incident Response Plan (IRP) to all stakeholders.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Request IR plan; Verify mandated annual testing in contract is flagged for Legal review. If answer is "No" and Vendor is an SC1 or SC2 criticality: Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: How often is your Incident Response Plan Tested?(Drop Down)
questions.control_objective: The organization maintains and makes available a current and viable Incident Response Plan (IRP) to all stakeholders.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Request IR plan; Verify mandated annual testing in contract is flagged for Legal review. If answer is "No" and Vendor is an SC1 or SC2 criticality: Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you have a policy requiring prompt notice to third parties regarding information security events affecting your organization?
questions.control_objective: Ensure that personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill its intended purpose and is securely disposed of when no longer needed. Facilitate the implementation of data protection controls across Regodit systems and services.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Request breach notification policy if vendor has not provided an assurance document such as an SOC 2 Type 2 report that covers this area; require remediation if missing; mandate contractual notification clauses. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Regardless of materiality, have you had a security event in the last 5 years?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "No": Sel-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "Yes" : Request details of past incidents; require corrective action evidence; escalate for high-risk history. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Do you outsource security functions to third-party providers?
questions.control_objective: Ensure that the organization monitors third-party personnel activity for potential security incidents, especially when security functions are outsourced.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "No": Sel-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "Yes" : Request list of providers; Get 1PD attestation that recent security reviews have been performed on the provided list of third-party providers. Verify mandated contractual obligations for providers is flagged for Legal review on the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you use anti virus software to protect your devices? If yes, describe.
questions.control_objective: Requires deployment of endpoint protection software (e.g., anti-virus, anti-malware) to detect and prevent threats such as ransomware and other cyber attacks.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate. Verify mandated endpoint protection verbiage is flagged for Legal review on the summary tab.

questions.question: Will your organization be accessing Client XYZ's network?
questions.control_objective: Develop, govern, and update procedures to implement network security controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "No": Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "Yes": Require network access controls; mandate MFA; escalate for exceptions.

questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to ensure asset ownership responsibilities are assigned, tracked and managed at a team, individual, or responsible organization level to establish a common understanding of requirements for asset protection.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes": Require attestation to Regodit's Acceptable Use policy. If answer is "No": Self-attestation is sufficient.

questions.question: Please list out all authorized personnel, including first and last names and e-mail addresses from your organization that will have access to Client XYZ's assets or network.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer to Security Question ID# 52 is "No": Security Question ID#'s 53 & 54 are not required. If answer to Security Question ID# 52 is "Yes": Require submission of personnel list. Verify mandated notifications for personnel changes is flagged for Legal review on the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Please submit a network architecture diagram and details of your endpoint protection measures, including how your organization complies with firewall and DNS security standards when accessing XYZ's networks.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer to Security Question ID# 52 is "No": Security Question ID#'s 53 & 54 are not required. If answer to Security Question ID# 52 is "Yes": Request network diagram and endpoint security details; Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Do you keep an inventory of information technology (IT) assets and software?
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to perform inventories of technology assets that: Accurately reflect the current systems, applications, and services in use; Identify authorized software products, including business justification details; Are at the level of granularity deemed necessary for tracking and reporting; Include organization-defined information necessary to achieve effective property accountability; Are available for review and audit by designated organizational personnel.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request more information on how assets are tracked. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate if pushback or no documents/attestation received from vendor.

questions.question: Does your organization have identity and access controls in place?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation of identification and access management controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Verify mandated MFA and least privilege verbiage is flagged for Legal review on the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Does your organization leverage role-based access control?
questions.control_objective: The organization enforces a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) policy over users and resources that applies need-to-know and fine-grained access control for sensitive/regulated data access.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Do you limit and periodically review user access privileges and controls?
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Verify mandated quarterly access review verbiage is flagged for Legal review on the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: What is the cadence of your access reviews?(Drop Down)
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "We don't have a formal cadence", "Other" or "N/A": Request scan frequency details, if not provided; Escalate for critical gaps. Ideal answer is "Quarterly", however anything greater than annual would merit escalation.

questions.question: Does your organization require replay-resistant authentication mechanisms such as OTP or MFA?
questions.control_objective: The organization uses automated mechanisms to employ replay-resistant access authentication.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request authentication mechanism details. Verify mandated MFA implementation obligation verbiage is flagged for Legal review in the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Are the external authenticators in use, NIST compliant?
questions.control_objective: The organization restricts the use of external authenticators to those that are National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)-compliant and maintain a list of accepted external authenticators.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request authentication mechanism details. Verify mandated NIST compliant MFA implementation obligation verbiage is flagged for Legal review in the summary tab. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Does your organization enforce the principle of least privilege?
questions.control_objective: The organization utilizes the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Do you conduct information security risk assessments at least annually?
questions.control_objective: The organization facilitates the implementation of strategic, operational and tactical risk management controls.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request risk assessment cadence. If no formal cadence or vendor does not perform risk assessments notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: How do you prioritize critical assets for your organization?
questions.control_objective: The organization prioritizes the impact level for systems, applications, and/or services to prevent potential disruptions.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If no response received or vendor gives pushback notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Does your organization conduct penetration testing at least annually?
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to regularly review technology assets for adherence to the organization’s cybersecurity & data protection policies and standards.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request Pentesting cadence. If no formal cadence, vendor does not perform pentests (internal or external) or pentesting is performed on a cadence greater than annually, notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.

questions.question: Have the findings from the most recent penetration test been remediated?
questions.control_objective: Mechanisms exist to regularly review technology assets for adherence to the organization’s cybersecurity & data protection policies and standards.
questions.reviewer_playbook: If answer is "Yes" : Self-attestation is sufficient. If answer is "No": Request findings detail and remediation timeline. Escalate if any critical or high vulnerabilities are outstanding. If remediation timeline is provided, set a followup when remediation is expected to complete. Notate engagement scope in reviewer comments in column I and escalate.
